policy.security_note: Hacktivist attacks documented against ComfyUI custom nodes (2024-2025). Custom nodes execute arbitrary Python. Allowlist is mandatory before any mission-use.

core_installation_policy.comfyui_core: Approved for isolated install if needed for FLUX benchmark (quantized variant)
core_installation_policy.comfyui_manager: Approved for managed node discovery, NOT for automatic node installation
core_installation_policy.isolation: Separate venv, no access to Foundry configs, no filesystem access outside cache/output dirs
